summary: Iteration 19 (frontend-only) verified the onboarding resume-step change (lastOnboardingScreen 25->23) on the public preview at 375x667. CORE FIX - PASS: full 20-question onboarding -> Generate My Profile -> generating -> /subscription?from=onboarding email gate -> top-left back arrow lands DIRECTLY on question 20/20 'What kind of partner do you want to call in?' (verified: 20/20 step label visible, 'Unlock Your Full Potential' paywall NOT shown, 'View My Plan Options' NOT shown, splash NOT shown). Paywall screen 25 is out of the back chain. FORWARD FLOW - PASS: from resumed q20, 'Generate My Profile' -> generating -> /subscription email gate again. REGRESSIONS - PASS: welcome -> 'Log in' -> /login 'Welcome Back' -> aria-label 'Go back' -> back to welcome step at /onboarding (iteration_7 behavior intact); fresh open with cleared localStorage starts at splash screen 1. NEW ISSUE FOUND (HIGH): previously entered answers are NOT retained on resume - the partner textarea came back EMPTY and Yes/No UNSELECTED with 'Generate My Profile' DISABLED (opacity 0.32, canNext=!!specificPerson), so the user is forced to re-answer question 20 before going forward again. This contradicts the stated requirement 'with previously entered answers retained'. Root cause: onboarding answers live in component useState (onboarding.tsx:577-596); router.replace('/subscription', from:'onboarding') UNMOUNTS the onboarding component and only the screen number is module-persisted (src/onboarding-progress.ts). In iteration_15/17 the back chain resumed at the paywall INSIDE the still-mounted onboarding component, so setScreen(23) kept state; now the resume happens after a fresh mount, so all answers reset. Zero app-breaking console errors (only benign audio play()/pause() interruption).

rca_of_issue: ISSUE: resumed q20 loses answers. REPRO: complete 20 questions (fill partner text + tap Yes) -> Generate My Profile -> generating -> email gate -> back arrow -> q20 shows EMPTY textarea, unselected Yes/No, disabled CTA. ROOT CAUSE: answers are useState in the Onboarding component (onboarding.tsx:577-596); router.replace('/subscription') unmounts it and router.replace('/onboarding') remounts fresh; src/onboarding-progress.ts persists only the step number. Previously masked because the resume target was the paywall (screen 25) which needs no answer state, and paywall->q20 used in-component setScreen(23) without unmount. MITIGATION: hoist answers to module-level storage or AsyncStorage and rehydrate on mount (at minimum partnerManifest + specificPerson for the q20 resume target).
